notes: cics-crucible condition-handling / hc-counter-increment-wrap (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): DCOUNTER with INCREMENT, GET WRAP at the default doubleword maximum (rewinds to the minimum), and a GET without WRAP at the limit. Scenarios restate the crucible's terminal steps; the oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs. Scenarios W and L walk the counter to the default doubleword maximum (X'FF..FF') and past it: #7589 keeps the counter-at-limit condition as a flag beside the value (not MAXIMUM + 1, which overflows), so GET without WRAP at the limit is SUPPRESSED RESP2 101 with the counter unchanged and GET WRAP rewinds it to the minimum (IBM, DEFINE COUNTER / GET COUNTER).

scenarios.name: incr
scenarios.why: DEFINE VALUE(10), GET INCREMENT(5) twice, QUERY, GET with the default increment, QUERY

scenarios.name: wrap
scenarios.why: DEFINE at max-2, GETs up to the default maximum, GET WRAP rewinds to the minimum, QUERY, GET

scenarios.name: limit
scenarios.why: DEFINE at max-1, GETs up to the maximum, then GET (with and without INCREMENT) without WRAP at the limit: SUPPRESSED RESP2 101, then GET WRAP and GET

scenarios.name: unmatched-mode
scenarios.why: a mode no WHEN names: the EVALUATE falls through
